podcast.description: The New York Times' daily news podcast — today's top story in 20 minutes.

stories.title: Everything announced at Made by Google ’26: Pixel 11, Pixel Watch 5, Pixel Tag, and tons of Gemini features
stories.description: From the Pixel 11 series and a brand new competitor to Apple’s AirTag, here are all the announcements from the Made by Google 2026 event.

stories.title: Google’s Quick Share adds a tap-to-share mode
stories.description: Google's Quick Share feature is getting a tap-to-share mode for quickly exchanging contacts, photos, videos, and more.

stories.description: Google focuses more on AI and curated experiences than spec upgrades in 2026.

stories.title: Google’s Pixel 11 lineup offer fewer hardware changes, but much more Gemini
stories.description: Google Pixel 11 Series starts $100 costlier than the last year, but offers 256GB base storage

stories.title: Double killer and rapist given whole life sentence
stories.description: Simon Levy, from Tottenham, will spend the rest of his life in prison for the murder of two women and rape of a third.

stories.title: Burnham considers disposable BBQ ban over wildfire risks
stories.description: The PM wants the public to avoid using single-use grills during the current spell of extremely dry weather.

stories.title: Jasper Carrott says family is 'so proud' of Lucy Davis after cancer diagnosis
stories.description: The actress, best known for playing Dawn in The Office, has revealed she has incurable breast cancer.

stories.title: Inflation eases in July as gasoline and grocery prices fall
stories.description: Consumer prices in July were up 3.4% from a year ago — a smaller annual increase than in May or June. The news makes it less likely the Fed will feel the need to raise interest rates in September.

stories.title: Greetings from a surreal expanse of sand dunes dotted with freshwater lagoons in Brazil
stories.description: The pristine white sand dunes of the Lençóis Maranhenses National Park are bordered by thick jungle on one side and the Atlantic Ocean on the other. Thousands of lagoons fill up after the rainy season.

stories.title: His wedding guests gave $6k to fund a health startup. Now it's won a $3 million prize
stories.description: Dr. Raj Panjabi founded Last Mile Health to bring healthcare to people living in remote areas. The group is the 2026 recipient of the Conrad N. Hilton Humanitarian Prize.

stories.title: Israeli settlers besieging Palestinian families in West Bank village
stories.description: Israeli security forces have reportedly withdrawn and about a dozen settlers are said to remain at the site where two families have been besieged since Sunday.

stories.title: Argentina star Messi not certain to play ‘much longer’ after father’s death
stories.description: Former Barcelona and PSG star Lionel Messi, who won the 2022 World Cup, hints at retirement from football.

stories.title: ‘Burn in hell’: Israeli settlers spread hate through graffiti, attacks
stories.description: Racist settler graffiti on West Bank homes and schools reveals a brazen ideological drive for Palestinian displacement.

stories.title: Sudanese army intercepts RSF drones over el-Obeid
stories.description: Sudanese army air defenses reportedly intercepted drones launched by the Rapid Support Forces (RSF) over el-Obeid.

stories.title: Why has North Korea fired a missile ahead of US-South Korea drills?
stories.description: Pyongyang has repeatedly condemned US–South Korea military drills, claiming they are a 'rehearsal for invasion'.

stories.title: Woman pulled alive from rubble 36 hours after Colombia quake
stories.description: Following a 10-hour rescue operation, emergency workers pulled the 32-year-old from beneath slabs of concrete.

stories.title: Mortgage rates finally stop rising, causing demand to trickle back
stories.description: Mortgage rates finally eased a tiny bit, but it was enough to bring some demand back to a very beleaguered mortgage market.

stories.title: Consumer prices rose 0.1% in July, as expected, putting the annual rate at 3.4%
stories.description: The consumer price index was expected to increase 0.1% in July, with an annual rate of 3.4%.

stories.title: Lumentum’s stock surges, giving a further boost to the optical-networking trade
stories.description: Excitement is building for Coherent’s earnings report after upbeat results from Lumentum.

stories.title: Google’s new Pixel 11 puts Gemini at center of AI phone battle with Apple
stories.description: Google is launching the Pixel 11 lineup weeks before Apple rolls out a rebuilt Siri powered by Gemini AI models.

stories.title: Trust, but hedge: Quietly violent summer lingers as bulls buy crash protection
stories.description: It's been a wild summer for stocks, even if it may not feel like it at surface level.

stories.title: Citadel Securities called the stock-market reset. Now it sees a leverage buildup on the horizon.
stories.description: Strategist Scott Rubner says a growing list of stock-market buyers are pushing it in a positive direction, notably big hedge funds and institutional managers.
